about_the_game:
Heroes Hooray Survivors is a fast-paced auto-shooter where you create a party of three heroes and try to survive 15 minute runs. Unlock new heroes, slay enemies and gain souls which can be used to make heroes stronger, improve party stats or gain new levels of abilities and thus make each run a bit more easier.

Each hero can have only three skills per run - so choose your abilities carefully! Once a hero has acquired three skills, the ultimate skill is unlocked for that hero which has longer cooldown than regular skills, but is much more powerful and devastating and can help you survive tough situations.

If you collect Fragments of Power or survive in the Favor arenas for long enough - you will be able to boost your party or hero stats and make it easier to survive and defeat powerful bosses!

Features:

  • 12 heroes

  • 60 unique abilities

  • 12 ultimate abilities that can be used automatically or manually

  • 4 levels of difficulty

  • 4 bosses

  • 15 minute runs

  • Controller support

  • Current content can be unlocked in 4-6 hours
